Overlap barplot for one ID level

Source: R/plots.R
plot_overlap_intra_condition.Rd

Builds a barplot showing how many IDs were detected in 1, 2, 3, … replicates per Condition, for a single pep_all-shaped data frame. Works for Peptides, Sequences, or Proteins by dispatching on id_col. Call it once per length subset (e.g. all peptides, then length-selected peptides) to get an individual plot for each.

Usage

plot_overlap_intra_condition(
  df,
  id_col,
  title = NULL,
  shortpep_range = c(8, 13),
  value = c("count", "percent")
)

Arguments

df

A pep_all-shaped data frame (e.g. pep_all, or the length-filtered pep_short).

id_col

Column defining the ID level: "Peptide", "Sequence", or "Accession".

title

Plot title. When NULL (default), a generic id-based label ("Nb Peptides" etc.) is used.

shortpep_range

Length-2 numeric vector c(min, max); retained for API compatibility (no longer used to build a subtitle now that all/short are plotted separately).

value

Y-axis mode: "count" (default, absolute number of IDs) or "percent" (the share of each Condition's IDs found in 1, 2, … replicates, stacked to 100%).

Value

A ggplot2 barplot of IDs by number of replicates, per Condition.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot_overlap_intra_condition(pep_all, "Peptide", title = "All Peptides")
plot_overlap_intra_condition(pep_short, "Accession")
plot_overlap_intra_condition(pep_all, "Peptide", value = "percent")
} # }
